decisions: DatePicker is a documented caller composition, not an invented exported Root. Stable caller data-part marks the recipe and the Button rendered by PopoverTrigger; source Popover slot and Calendar slot delegate exact visual/behavioral parts to those complete contracts through explicit CSS imports. Native 32px trigger minimum is retained but localized date text can wrap. Preferred intrinsic popup with zero wrapper padding lets Calendar own 8px inset; explicit data-date-picker-popup marker applies the same surface rule to the actual portal. Compact native 28px Calendar cells are chosen in this recipe to fit narrow viewports. Trigger text names the current date; persistent availability instructions and actual dialog labelledby retain semantic relationships. Selection does not implicitly close the official basic recipe, Escape restores trigger focus, and popup open authority remains separate from Date selection. No coordinate-based selector or fixed native preview box remains.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
